what_this_is: RP63's recipe and architecture contrast, RE-RUN with the arms matched on optimiser updates and one arm-independent monitor; the measurement the MOD-CORE-PRETRAIN block names as its second prerequisite

source_run.reading: the prepared DATA of that run is consumed by digest; nothing is re-enumerated, so every arm sees exactly the rows it saw

task.reach_measured_by: perturbation and gradient per input row (tools/df_e1_receiver.py), not asserted
task.reach_note: ARCH-A with the sequence fusion depends on the last `model_reach_steps` samples of the window (branch 5 + core 3 - 1); the window is the declared context, the reach is what the prediction can depend on (RP28: full real reach declared)

graph.core: causal dilated Conv1D stack with dilations [1, 2, 4, 8, 16] (kernel 3, 16 filters, residual), reach 60 positions: derived from W, not searched
graph.grouping: held constant: physical groups (power: active history, reactive, intensity | voltage | sub-metering 1-3); profile-based grouping is a separate factor not varied here

layers.detector (per branch): 2 residual causal Conv1D blocks: Conv1D(16, k=3, d=1, ELU) + 1x1 projection skip
layers.core: Conv1D(16, k=3, causal, ELU) on the channel-concatenated branch sequences, last position
layers.head: Dense(p) increment over the last observation (persistence skip); the target channel is read out
layers.readout: the model output at the target's input channel; only that channel is trained and scored

graph.initial_weights: keras set_random_seed(seed) before build: the SAME initial checkpoint for R0/R1/R2 of a seed (digest recorded per unit)

regimes.R1: detector from ae_s (masked AE, train windows only), frozen
regimes.R2: detector from ae_s, adjustable (same imported weights as R1)

training.monitor_declaration: one fixed, arm-independent monitor for every arm: the measure the question is judged by. The trained loss never chooses the stopping epoch or the restored checkpoint

reference_model.paper: Bai, Kolter & Koltun 2018, An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling (arXiv:1803.01271)
reference_model.block: weight_norm(Conv1d) -> chomp -> ReLU -> Dropout, twice, + 1x1 residual, then ReLU
reference_model.ours_for_contrast: one Conv1D(k=3, ELU) + 1x1 projection skip, no weight norm, no dropout, no activation after the sum

arms.what_differs: our core, MSE loss in z-space, early stopping on validation MSE — the run's own recipe
our core, MAE loss in z-space, early stopping on validation MAE — aligned with the measure the question is judged by
the reference TCN block (Bai/locuslab, ported and parameter-matched), MSE loss, early stopping on validation MSE — the architecture contrast at the run's own recipe

replicas.pairing: every arm of a seed starts from the same initial weights where the graph is the same; the reference block is a different graph and cannot share them, which is stated, not hidden

metrics.mae: kW on the common evaluation set, recomputed from arrays at closure

governance: one campaign and one verified delivery per unit before it runs; a terminal through the outbox and a reconciled campaign after it
reading_rules: three seeds on one task are development evidence, not a confirmation
every arm ran the same number of optimiser updates, so no difference between arms carries a budget the others did not get
an arm that stops at the update ceiling is CENSORED: what it would reach with more budget is unknown, in either direction
no cell is removed after its score is seen

benchmark_contract.target_construction: minute-averaged active power, kW, as published; not aggregated
benchmark_contract.split_rule: DEV slice rows 1412361..1462761 (28 d train / 7 d validation) inside the family's train span; family test never read
benchmark_contract.missing_policy: rows with a non-finite input withdrawn from the enumeration; nothing imputed
benchmark_contract.scaler_fit_population: train windows (each row weighted by the windows containing it)
benchmark_contract.metric_formula: MAE = mean |yhat - y| over the common evaluation set; MAE_z = MAE / sd_train
benchmark_contract.metric_aggregation: mean over 10020 evaluation origins, one horizon
benchmark_contract.naive_baseline: persistence at the horizon, y(t), on identical origins
benchmark_contract.permitted_inputs: the 7 declared channels (6 features + the target's own history), window 60
benchmark_contract.checkpoint_selection: best validation MAE, patience 3 epochs, restored

comparability.why: unknown identity fields cannot match as proof: ['target_transform']

reference_evidence.why: an unknown protocol has no reference lane; read the source first

comparability.resolution: read the primary source (or its code) and fill the field; a placeholder is not a protocol
comparability.rule: decided from the identity fields, never from a score

repairs.parent_monitor: each arm monitors the loss it trains on; the arm's identifier says which
repairs.defect_1: the monitor was the arm's own trained loss, so it chose the stopping epoch
repairs.defect_2: the monitor also chose the restored checkpoint, on a different curve per arm
repairs.consequence: the arms were given different optimiser-update counts and the winner got more
repairs.repair: one fixed monitor (val_mae) for every arm, and a fixed update count for every cell

custody.why: this round may not start or contact a governance or warehouse service, so no campaign is registered and no terminal is reported; the prepared DATA is consumed from the retained phase-1 root by digest
what_this_forfeits: no accepted delivery precedes the fits
no accepted terminal anchors the metrics
the rows of its closure table can never read `verified`
what_it_keeps: the same prepared bytes, checked by digest before any fit
metrics recomputed in float64 from the saved arrays
a fresh-process replay of every cell from its saved weights
